secret_scan.limitation: pattern scanner, not proof of absence

package.smoke_test: recorded rule replay on development fixtures; not new live teaching

review.scope: read-only review; independent reviewer confirmed fixes; no live holdout inspected

limitations: Single teacher lesson; task groups are not independent training replications.
The lesson task was solvable by traversal in one step; necessity of help was not demonstrated.
Question wording is templated; the pretrained ask chooser was not updated in this lesson.
Direct rule-memory baseline matched the learned selector.
Negative transfer on scrambled layouts; fallback timing was preprogrammed.
Developer and live teacher were the same assistant, not independent blinded roles.
Partial lesson sessions lock on interruption; automatic crash recovery is not implemented.
No open-world search or learned persistent self-model; subjective experience untested.
publication: local artifacts only; no remote CI, GitHub or PyPI publication
